Type: ceramic cutout lantern, set of two
Use: candle light on tables, shelves or floor; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, bohemian, coastal
Materials: glazed ceramic, macrame rope handle, dark base
Colors: cream with ochre edges, deep teal blue
Shape: rounded jar-shaped lantern with geometric lattice cutouts, braided rope handle, medium and sculptural
Feel: warm, crafted, relaxed
Goes with: natural wood, rattan, white walls, blue or neutral textiles; farmhouse, bohemian or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Farmhouse Decorative Candle Holder Lantern with Cutouts - Set of 2, Cream and Blue
product.description: These 2 stoneware containers boast a unique cut-out pattern that makes them ideal for mood lighting and holding dry flowers. They come in cream and blue with an elegant trim and a handle for easy transport. 9.5" Diameter x 12"H; 7" Diameter x 9.75"H Stoneware Decorative container This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth.
